title: Identification and characterization of novel splice variants of human farnesoid X receptor.
authors: Mustonen, Enni-Kaisa; Lee, Serene M L; Niess, Hanno; Schwab, Matthias; Pantsar, Tatu; Burk, Oliver
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定人类FXR核受体的新型剪接变体，结合分子动力学模拟解释其DNA结合与转录活性缺陷，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但涉及核受体-DNA互作机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Farnesoid X receptor (FXR, NR1H4) is a ligand-activated nuclear receptor, which regulates bile acid, lipid and glucose metabolism. Due to these functions, FXR has been investigated as a potential drug target for the treatment of liver diseases, such as primary biliary cholangitis and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Based on the previously described four splice variants, it has been suggested that alternative promoter usage and splicing may have an impact on total FXR activity as a result of encoding functionally diverse variants. Here we aimed for a systematic analysis of human hepatic FXR splice variants. In addition to the previously described FXRalpha1-4, we identified four novel splice variants (FXRalpha5-8) in human hepatocytes, which resulted from previously undetected exon skipping events. These newly identified isoforms displayed diminished DNA binding and impaired transactivation activities. Isoform FXRalpha5, which suppressed the transactivation activity of the functional isoform FXRalpha2, was further characterized as deficient in heterodimerization, coactivator recruitment and ligand binding. These findings were further supported by molecular dynamics simulations, which offered an explanation for the behavior of this isoform on the molecular level. FXRalpha5 exhibited low uniform expression levels in nearly all human tissues. Our systematic analysis of FXR splice variants in human hepatocytes resulted in the identification of four novel FXR isoforms, which all proved to be functionally deficient, but one novel variant, FXRalpha5, also displayed dominant negative activity. The possible associations with and roles of these novel isoforms in human liver diseases require further investigation.
abstract_zh: 法尼醇X受体（FXR, NR1H4）是一种配体激活的核受体，调节胆汁酸、脂质和葡萄糖代谢。鉴于这些功能，FXR已被研究作为治疗肝脏疾病（如原发性胆汁性胆管炎和非酒精性脂肪性肝炎）的潜在药物靶点。基于先前描述的四种剪接变体，有研究表明，替代启动子的使用和剪接可能通过编码功能多样的变体而影响总FXR活性。在此，我们旨在对人类肝脏FXR剪接变体进行系统性分析。除了先前描述的FXRalpha1-4外，我们在人类肝细胞中鉴定出四种新的剪接变体（FXRalpha5-8），这些变体源于先前未检测到的外显子跳跃事件。这些新发现的异构体表现出减弱的DNA结合能力和受损的反式激活活性。其中，异构体FXRalpha5抑制了功能性异构体FXRalpha2的反式激活活性，并被进一步表征为在异二聚化、共激活因子招募和配体结合方面存在缺陷。这些发现得到了分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟的进一步支持，该模拟在分子水平上为这种异构体的行为提供了解释。FXRalpha5在几乎所有人类组织中表现出低且均匀的表达水平。我们对人类肝细胞中FXR剪接变体的系统性分析鉴定出四种新的FXR异构体，所有这些异构体均被证明功能缺陷，但其中一种新变体FXRalpha5还表现出显性负性活性。这些新异构体在人类肝脏疾病中的可能关联和作用需要进一步研究。
